summary: Frontend-only testing of new /workout live-workout screen and /training regression. All /workout sections render correctly (top bar, power/hr/cadence cards, workout-timeline, rider viewport, climb/route/wearable cards, ride-summary-strip, trainer control bar, alberto-cue). Live telemetry loop is ticking (elapsed 00:24:40 -> 00:24:44 over ~3.2s). Pause toggles PAUSE<->RESUME with toast; ERG +/- adjusts intensity (100 -> 105 -> 100 -> 95) with toast; controls-button opens overlay showing all 10 ctrl-* items; tapping ctrl-skip fires toast 'Skip Interval' and closes overlay; controls-close closes overlay. Navigation: /training -> /workout via start-workout-button, /workout -> /training via end-workout-button. Home '/' still renders. REGRESSION FAILURE: /training bottom row cards are NOT equal width (before-you-ride-card=244.83px vs fb50-card/mpc-card=210.84px, diff=33.98px > 2px). Root cause: PreRideCard's LinearGradient root uses styles.bottomCard directly; unlike fb50/mpc which are wrapped in Touchable with containerStyle={flex:1, flexBasis:0, minWidth:0}, PreRideCard does not have an equivalent outer flex container that reliably applies flex-basis:0 on the web layout.

ui_bugs.issue: Bottom-row card is ~34px wider than sibling cards (244.83px vs 210.84px). The flex:1/flexBasis:0/minWidth:0 declared on styles.bottomCard is not equalizing when applied directly to the LinearGradient root, while fb50/mpc use an outer Touchable wrapper with containerStyle that includes those flex props. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/training.tsx:303 (PreRideCard LinearGradient root) vs lines 326 & 366 (fb50/mpc Touchable wrappers).

Web-only warning; consider setting useNativeDriver:false explicitly on web or gating it, otherwise harmless. Reference: /app/frontend/app/workout.tsx:47-48.

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Move pointerEvents from prop to style. Reference: /app/frontend/app/workout.tsx:53 and /app/frontend/src/components/workout.tsx:430.

Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'textShadow*' deprecated (use textShadow). Coming from theme/shadow helpers. Not blocking but should be modernized. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.* (shadow definitions).

rca_of_issue: Regression on /training bottom row: PreRideCard renders its LinearGradient directly with styles.bottomCard (flex:1, flexBasis:0, minWidth:0). On the RN-Web layout, flex-basis:0 + minWidth:0 declared on the flex item itself is not being honoured for this LinearGradient element, so its intrinsic content width wins over its siblings. The fb50-card and mpc-card avoid this by wrapping their LinearGradient/View in a Touchable that receives containerStyle={{flex:1, flexBasis:0, minWidth:0}} — the outer wrapper becomes the flex item. Fix: mirror that pattern for PreRideCard by wrapping it in an outer <View style={{flex:1, flexBasis:0, minWidth:0}}> (or a Touchable) so the flex item and the visual card are separate elements. Reproduction: open /training at 1194x834, measure widths of before-you-ride-card, fb50-card, mpc-card via getBoundingClientRect(); observe ~34px delta.
